description: Walk the Georgia standards hierarchy one level at a time. With no arguments, returns the four subjects. Pass `subject` (optionally with `grade`) for that subject's courses, or pass a row's `id` back as `parent` to open it. `grade` works only with `subject` (or a `subject:<subj>` parent) and is ignored when opening any other row. Math courses have a strand layer between course and standard. Each row has an `id` (pass it back as `parent`), `code`, `title`, `cf_item_type` (the row's level in the state's data: Course, Domain, Content Standard, and so on), `kind`, `has_children`, `child_count`, and `gmas` / `ald` flags (whether the Milestones blueprints or the achievement-level descriptors cover it).

grade.description: One grade: 'K' (or 'KG') or '01' through '12'. '1' through '9' also work. Requires subject.
grade.title: Grade

parent.description: A row `id` from an earlier call: a row identifier, 'subject:<subject>', or 'synth:math_strand:<course id>:<strand code>'.
parent.title: Parent
